name: safeher
description: SafeHer - Travel Freely. Stay Safely. Full-Stack Women Safety Web Application

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.build: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
